crowd.buyer: Whoever your idea is for: you'll find out who in 25 conversations
crowd.note: Middle scores on purpose: every idea starts unknown. The 25 conversations tell you whether people have the problem now and already spend time or money on it.
not_yet: Don't build a website, logo or app before 25 conversations.
Don't ask people if they like your idea. Ask about the last time the problem happened.
Don't quit anything or spend savings on an idea you haven't tested.
